summary: This SVG creates a small icon showing a terminal prompt. It draws a rounded dark rectangle as the background and places a green greater-than symbol in the center to represent the command prompt character you'd see in a terminal.

explanations.1: The viewBox attribute defines the coordinate system as a 64x64 square, so all positions are measured within that space. The role and aria-label make this icon accessible to screen readers.
explanations.2: rx and ry create rounded corners on the rectangle — they define the radius of the curve at each corner.
explanations.3: text-anchor="middle" centers the text horizontally at x=32, and dominant-baseline="middle" centers it vertically at y=40. The font-family lists fallbacks in case JetBrains Mono isn't available.
